# Model and drive construction

Parameter names and defaults are taken from implementation signatures; explanations are in
`docs/parameters.toml`. Dataclass fields use their source attribute docstrings. Required
arguments are marked explicitly. The [model guide](../models.md) explains physical conventions.

## Reference junction

`qdjj_solver.reference_model`

### `bath`

Default: `required`. Required DiscreteBath, reused for matched leads. Its weights represent the normal-state measure.

### `u`

Default: `2.0`. Finite charging energy U of the single orbital.

### `gamma`

Default: `0.4`. Nonnegative finite total hybridization, summed over the leads; energy units.

### `phi`

Default: `1.8849555921538759`. Finite phase difference phi_R-phi_L in radians; junction phases are [-phi/2, +phi/2].

### `rho_ws`

Default: `0.0`. Finite dimensionless rho W_S, the spin-dependent direct contact; zero for a single lead.

### `rho_wn`

Default: `0.0`. Finite dimensionless rho W_N, the normal direct contact; zero for a single lead.

### `geometry`

Default: `'junction'`. 'junction' for two leads or 'single' for one.

### `detuning`

Default: `0.0`. Finite epsilon_d+U/2 in energy units; zero is particle-hole symmetry.

### `field`

Default: `0.0`. Finite Zeeman energy acting only on the dot and multiplying S_z; positive values raise the spin-up level.

### `symmetry`

Default: `True`. Use eta coordinates when the gate, contacts and bath satisfy the required symmetries.

### `compress`

Default: `True`. Freeze eligible dark modes in their vacuum. Use False for a full finite-bath spectrum and arbitrary electron operators. The unified CLI defaults this to false.

### `bath_reference`

Default: `'isolated'`. 'isolated' BCS reservoirs or a 'coupled' quadratic environment; the latter requires a gapped, unpolarized, spin-conserving reservoir vacuum.

### `coefficient_tolerance`

Default: `1e-14`. Nonnegative finite absolute threshold for numerical coefficient truncation, in energy units.

## General impurity model

`qdjj_solver.make_model`

### `impurity`

Default: `required`. Impurity defining physical electron operators on M spinful orbitals.

### `baths`

Default: `required`. Nonempty sequence of L DiscreteBath reservoirs.

### `tunneling`

Default: `required`. L finite complex matrices of shape (2, 2*M), in energy units; reservoir-spin rows and impurity-spin columns.

### `phases`

Default: `None`. L finite phases in radians; None means zero phases.

### `direct`

Default: `None`. Mapping (l,m) to a finite complex 2-by-2 contact matrix, l<m; None means no direct contacts.

### `phase_velocities`

Default: `None`. L finite derivatives of lead phase with respect to the chosen phase coordinate. None means zero; nonzero values generate phase_derivative.

### `eta_basis`

Default: `False`. Request verified eta coordinates; restricted to a matched symmetric single-dot junction.

### `compress_pairs`

Default: `False`. Freeze discarded dark modes; requires eligible eta coordinates and no finite direct W_S coupling.

### `bath_reference`

Default: `'isolated'`. 'isolated' or 'coupled'. Coupled coordinates require spin-conserving direct hopping and a nonzero reservoir excitation gap.

### `coefficient_tolerance`

Default: `1e-14`. Nonnegative finite threshold for numerical coefficient truncation, in energy units.

### `direct_derivatives`

Default: `None`. Named contact-operator mappings in the same form as direct; each name must be distinct from impurity observables and phase_derivative.

## Cosh quadrature

`qdjj_solver.cosh_grid`

### `pairs`

Default: `required`. Positive integer number of mirrored pairs of signed normal levels per reservoir; each level has two spin modes.

### `delta`

Default: `1.0`. Positive finite superconducting gap in energy units.

### `bandwidth`

Default: `100.0`. Positive finite normal-state half-bandwidth in the same energy units. Coarse weights retain their quadrature values.

## Fitted surrogate reservoir

`qdjj_solver.fit_surrogate`

### `levels`

Default: `required`. Positive integer number of signed spinful normal levels per reservoir. An odd number of levels includes a normal-state node at zero energy.

### `delta`

Default: `1.0`. Positive finite superconducting gap in energy units.

### `bandwidth`

Default: `100.0`. Positive finite normal-state half-bandwidth in energy units.

### `frequency_cutoff`

Default: `100.0`. Upper positive imaginary-frequency fit boundary; same energy units as the gap.

### `frequency_min`

Default: `0.001`. Positive lower fit boundary, smaller than frequency_cutoff.

### `frequency_points`

Default: `1000`. Integer number of logarithmically spaced fit points, at least ten.

### `starts`

Default: `4`. Positive number of optimization attempts with different initial guesses; the successful fit with the smallest objective value is retained.

### `seed`

Default: `1729`. Random-generator seed for reproducible initial guesses.

### `relative_weight`

Default: `0.0`. Finite real exponent controlling frequency weighting of the residual; zero uses the absolute objective.

### `max_nfev`

Default: `5000`. Positive maximum number of function evaluations per optimization attempt. Assess the resulting bath accuracy through fit diagnostics and observable convergence.

## Padé chain-expansion reservoir

`qdjj_solver.chain_expansion`

### `levels`

Default: `required`. Positive number of spinful sites in one reservoir, returned in mirrored star coordinates.

### `delta`

Default: `1.0`. Positive finite superconducting gap in energy units.

### `bandwidth`

Default: `100.0`. Positive finite half-bandwidth; in wide-band mode it only sets density normalization.

### `wide_band`

Default: `False`. Boolean selecting an infinite-band target; False retains the specified finite flat band.

## Anderson impurity

`qdjj_solver.Impurity.anderson`

### `u`

Default: `2.0`. Finite coefficient U in U(n-1)^2/2, in energy units.

### `detuning`

Default: `0.0`. Finite epsilon_d+U/2, multiplying n-1.

### `field`

Default: `0.0`. Finite Zeeman energy multiplying S_z, acting on the impurity only.

## Impurity from integrals

`qdjj_solver.Impurity.from_integrals`

### `one_body`

Default: `required`. Finite even-dimensional square spin-orbital matrix h_ab in sum h_ab d_a† d_b.

### `interaction`

Default: `None`. Optional finite tensor U_abcd with all four dimensions equal to one_body's dimension; enters as one quarter times U_abcd d_a† d_b† d_d d_c.

### `constant`

Default: `0.0`. Finite additive scalar energy retained by the Hamiltonian.

## Single cosine drive

`qdjj_solver.ParameterDrive.cosine`

### `parameter`

Default: `required`. Builder keyword name; its undriven value must be present in base.

### `amplitude`

Default: `required`. Finite real amplitude in that parameter's units (radians for phases).

### `phase`

Default: `0.0`. Finite real cosine phase offset, in radians.

### `order`

Default: `1`. Positive integer harmonic order relative to omega.

### `index`

Default: `None`. Optional nonnegative array-element index; None selects a scalar parameter.

## Periodic model from driven parameters

`qdjj_solver.PeriodicHamiltonian.from_parameters`

### `builder`

Default: `required`. Callable returning a Hamiltonian from the keyword arguments in base.

### `base`

Default: `required`. Undriven keyword mapping; it must explicitly include every driven parameter.

### `drives`

Default: `required`. One ParameterDrive or a sequence, with each parameter/index pair driven only once.

### `omega`

Default: `required`. Positive finite drive angular frequency, in energy units with hbar=1.

### `samples`

Default: `64`. Integer number of equally spaced samples per period, at least three; refine to check Fourier resolution.

### `coefficient_tolerance`

Default: `1e-14`. Nonnegative coefficient cleanup scale applied to harmonics.

### `sampling_tolerance`

Default: `1e-09`. Acceptance scale for the midpoint interpolation-error bound, in energy units.

### `verify`

Default: `True`. Verify the Fourier reconstruction at sample midpoints; failures raise an error.

### `observables`

Default: `True`. Also sample model observables and store their time-dependent harmonics.

## Periodic model from a time-dependent function

`qdjj_solver.PeriodicHamiltonian.from_callable`

### `function`

Default: `required`. Callable function(t) returning a Hamiltonian at time t.

### `omega`

Default: `required`. Positive finite angular frequency, defining the period 2*pi/omega.

### `samples`

Default: `64`. Integer number of samples over the period, at least three.

### `reference`

Default: `None`. Static Hamiltonian whose eigenstates define the tracked-state labels; None uses the time average.

### `assume_fixed_coordinates`

Default: `False`. Explicitly assume fixed coordinates for a model without coordinate metadata. Valid use requires a time-independent canonical basis.

### `coefficient_tolerance`

Default: `1e-14`. Nonnegative coefficient cleanup scale applied to harmonics.

### `sampling_tolerance`

Default: `1e-09`. Midpoint interpolation-error acceptance scale, in energy units.

### `verify`

Default: `True`. Check the reconstructed Fourier series at sample midpoints.

### `observables`

Default: `True`. Sample the function's named observables as well as the Hamiltonian.

## High-frequency effective Hamiltonian

`qdjj_solver.PeriodicHamiltonian.van_vleck`

### `order`

Default: `2`. Perturbative order 0, 1 or 2 in inverse omega; requires high frequency relative to the many-body width.

### `tolerance`

Default: `1e-14`. Absolute coefficient cleanup scale after full-operator commutators.

### `max_harmonic`

Default: `None`. Largest nonnegative Hamiltonian harmonic used; None uses every stored harmonic.

## Discrete reservoir fields

`qdjj_solver.DiscreteBath`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/baths.py`.

### `xi`

Type: `np.ndarray`. Default: `required`.

Nonempty one-dimensional finite signed normal energies, in Hamiltonian energy units.

### `weights`

Type: `np.ndarray`. Default: `required`.

Strictly positive normal-state measure weights, same shape as `xi`; their supplied values are preserved.

### `delta`

Type: `float`. Default: `1.`.

Positive finite superconducting gap in energy units.

### `bandwidth`

Type: `float`. Default: `100.`.

Positive finite normal-state half-bandwidth; sets the density per spin to 1/(2D).

### `metadata`

Type: `dict`. Default: `dict()`.

Construction parameters, fit diagnostics and optional user provenance.

## Impurity fields

`qdjj_solver.Impurity`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/models.py`.

### `orbitals`

Type: `int`. Default: `required`.

Positive number of physical impurity orbitals; each contributes up/down spin modes.

### `operator`

Type: `FermionOperator`. Default: `required`.

Hermitian, parity-conserving impurity operator in physical electron coordinates.

### `observables`

Type: `dict[str, FermionOperator]`. Default: `dict()`.

Additional impurity operators; charge, spin-z and orbital double occupancies are added automatically.

### `metadata`

Type: `dict`. Default: `dict()`.

Physical construction parameters and optional user information.

## Hamiltonian fields

`qdjj_solver.Hamiltonian`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/problem.py`.

### `operator`

Type: `FermionOperator`. Default: `required`.

Finite Hermitian, parity-conserving polynomial in the declared canonical modes.

### `nimp`

Type: `int`. Default: `required`.

Number of impurity spin modes, occupying the first mode indices; zero is allowed.

### `spins`

Type: `tuple[int, ...]`. Default: `required`.

Twice-spin labels +1 or -1 for every canonical mode, in basis order.

### `eta_labels`

Type: `tuple[int, ...] | None`. Default: `None`.

Optional +1/-1 eta label per mode; required when imposing eta parity.

### `observables`

Type: `dict[str, FermionOperator]`. Default: `dict()`.

Named operators in the same canonical coordinates as the Hamiltonian.

### `metadata`

Type: `dict`. Default: `dict()`.

Construction, energy-reference and coordinate information; may include user entries.

## Symmetry sector fields

`qdjj_solver.Sector`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/problem.py`.

### `parity`

Type: `int`. Default: `1`.

Total fermion parity: zero is even and one is odd; it includes impurity and bath.

### `twice_sz`

Type: `int | None`. Default: `1`.

Twice total spin projection, an integer compatible with parity; `None` leaves it unrestricted.

### `eta`

Type: `int | None`. Default: `None`.

Optional eta parity, +1 or -1; requires declared eta labels and a conserving Hamiltonian.

### `particle_number`

Type: `int | None`. Default: `None`.

Optional nonnegative total occupation of the chosen canonical modes, compatible with parity and spin.

## Cosine component fields

`qdjj_solver.Harmonic`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/floquet.py`.

### `order`

Type: `int`. Default: `required`.

Positive integer multiple of the fundamental drive frequency.

### `amplitude`

Type: `float`. Default: `required`.

Finite real cosine amplitude in the driven parameter's units.

### `phase`

Type: `float`. Default: `0.`.

Finite cosine phase offset in radians.

## Parameter modulation fields

`qdjj_solver.ParameterDrive`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/floquet.py`.

### `parameter`

Type: `str`. Default: `required`.

Nonempty keyword name in the model builder's undriven parameter mapping.

### `harmonics`

Type: `tuple[Harmonic, ...]`. Default: `required`.

Nonempty sequence of cosine components with distinct positive orders.

### `index`

Type: `int | None`. Default: `None`.

Optional nonnegative index of an array parameter; `None` selects a scalar parameter.

## Periodic Hamiltonian fields

`qdjj_solver.PeriodicHamiltonian`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/common/floquet.py`.

### `omega`

Type: `float`. Default: `required`.

Positive finite fundamental angular frequency in energy units with hbar=1.

### `harmonics`

Type: `dict[int, FermionOperator]`. Default: `required`.

Nonnegative Fourier indices mapped to operators; negative harmonics are Hermitian conjugates.

### `nimp`

Type: `int`. Default: `required`.

Number of impurity spin modes, identical for every harmonic and the reference.

### `spins`

Type: `tuple[int, ...]`. Default: `required`.

Twice-spin label +1 or -1 per fixed canonical mode.

### `eta_labels`

Type: `tuple[int, ...] | None`. Default: `None`.

Optional eta label per mode; fixed across all harmonics.

### `reference`

Type: `Hamiltonian | None`. Default: `None`.

Static Hamiltonian defining tracked state labels; `None` uses the time average.

### `observables`

Type: `dict[str, dict[int, FermionOperator]]`. Default: `dict()`.

Named operator harmonics, allowing both positive and negative Fourier indices.

### `metadata`

Type: `dict`. Default: `dict()`.

Coordinate declarations, drive settings, sampling diagnostics and optional user entries.

## Prepared MPS model fields

`qdjj_solver.dmrg_solver.PreparedModel`; source: `src/qdjj_solver/dmrg_solver/mpo.py`.

### `hamiltonian`

Type: `Hamiltonian`. Default: `required`.

Original physical finite Hamiltonian, before MPS layout selection.

### `sector`

Type: `Sector`. Default: `required`.

Selected total symmetry quantum numbers.

### `order`

Type: `tuple[int, ...]`. Default: `required`.

Permutation of zero-based canonical mode indices along the MPS.

### `groups`

Type: `tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]`. Default: `required`.

Canonical modes grouped into each MPS site, one or two per site.

### `sites`

Type: `list`. Default: `required`.

TeNPy local fermionic sites with the selected conserved charges.

### `lattice`

Type: `TrivialLattice`. Default: `required`.

Finite open TeNPy lattice of the grouped sites; a computational ordering.

### `mode_operators`

Type: `dict`. Default: `required`.

Canonical mode mapped to its site index and local annihilation/creation names.

### `target_charge`

Type: `tuple[int, ...]`. Default: `required`.

Total TeNPy charge labels encoding the selected sector.

### `coordinate_id`

Type: `str`. Default: `required`.

Fingerprint of physical coordinates, ordering, grouping and conserved-charge types.
